alerts.title: Fordyce Bathhouse Closed Thanksgiving Day
alerts.description: The Fordyce Bathhouse Visitor Center and Museum will be closed on Thursday, November 26, 2026. Outdoor areas of the park, including trails, springs, and fountains, will remain open to the public from 5:00am to 10:00pm Check local businesses for similar closures.

alerts.title: Burn Ban in Park
alerts.description: Due to high fire danger, Hot Springs National Park has enacted a BURN BAN, August 15, 2026. Only gas and charcoal grills are currently allowed for use in the campground and picnic areas.
